sources: Esri World Imagery z17 with the catalog site points

values.note: FS: 17 sites with parking spurs of 25-40 ft, maximum RV length 25 ft. recreation.gov's catalog lists 16: 13 standard sites and 3 tent-only (013-015); among the standard sites, 001, 005, 009, 010, 017 list 24 ft, 008 and 011 35 ft, 012 is a 40-ft pull-through, and 003, 004, 006, 007, 016 list 14-18 ft.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/jefferson-creek-campground ('Jefferson Creek Campground has 17 campsites with parking spurs of 25-40 feet'; 'The max length for RVs is 25 feet') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233723 ('the max RV length 25 feet') + catalog 233723 (Max Vehicle Length, Driveway Entry Pull-through on 012), read 2026-10-28

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/jefferson-creek-campground ('Vault Toilet'; 'Potable water is available at this site. A hand pump is available.'), read 2026-10-28

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/jefferson-creek-campground ('This campground is open mid-May to mid-October, weather dependent'; 'Seasons of Use: Mid-May to mid-October'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Reserve at least 5 days ahead (FS says four); sites not reserved by then become first-come walk-ups, and walk-ups are exempt from the minimums. recreation.gov marks the weekend minimum 'soft', so it may be relaxed for a same-day booking. 2026 recreation.gov season May 15 - Oct 11.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233723 (rules minWeekendStay 2 'soft', maxConsecutiveStay 14, reservationCutOff 5; notice 'Sites not reserved 5 days before become walk-up and are available on a first come - first serve bases') + /rates (2026 Peak Season 05-15 to 10-11) + FS page ('A minimum stay on Friday and Saturday night is required on weekends. A three-night minimum stay is required on holiday weekends. Walk-ups are exempt from the nightly minimum'; 'No more than a 14-night consecutive stay'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: $24 a site (two vehicles or one RV); $11 a third vehicle. Plus a one-time $11 entry fee to the Jefferson Lake Recreation Area for the stay.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/jefferson-creek-campground ('$24 fee per site for overnight camping ... $11 fee for a third vehicle') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233723 ('There is a one-time fee of $11.00 to enter Jefferson Lake Recreation Area') + /rates (2026 Peak 24), read 2026-10-28

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/jefferson-creek-campground ('The Interagency Senior Pass and the Interagency Access Pass qualify for a 50% discount at concessionaire-run campsites'), read 2026-10-28

note: Pike NF campground at ~10,100 ft in the Jefferson Lake Recreation Area, strung along a forested ridge above the Jefferson Creek valley, a mile below Jefferson Lake; Colorado Trail access. Bear country (bear-resistant storage order). Access via unpaved CR-37, not plowed in winter. --Claude
summary: FS page + recreation.gov: confirmed 17 sites, max RV 25 ft (FS figure), no hookups, vault toilet, hand-pump water, $24, recreation.gov with walk-ups. Added pull-through (site 012), 14-night max, weekend 2 / holiday 3-night minimums, booking.season 05-15..10-11, season mid-May-mid-Oct (note), senior/access discount, entry-fee note. Note trimmed of field facts.
flags: Waterfront: stored riverview is wrong in kind. Jefferson Creek here is a narrow stream (willow-and-beaver-pond bottom, well under 30 m), so river vocabulary does not apply, and there is no creek-view value. On Esri imagery the sites run along a densely forested ridge 60-100 m SW of the willow bottom with conifers between; no site is at the creek's edge. 'not waterfront' fits - re-audit lead.
Missing phone: South Park Ranger District 719-836-2031 (FS campground page contact block). recreation.gov gives the concessionaire's (661) 702-1420 (goexplorus.com).
Operator: concessionaire-run (Explorus per recreation.gov contact). Ownership federal stands.
Sites: FS 17; recreation.gov catalog 16 (no 002), 3 of them tent-only, so 13 RV-usable standard sites, 8 of which list 24 ft or more.

Road: CR 37 is 'an unpaved gravel surface road' (recreation.gov) and is not maintained for snow; no RV, 4WD or high-clearance wording. No PSICC alert or order names CR 37 or the Jefferson Lake Recreation Area.

Pin 39.43526,-105.85378 (the FS page coordinate) sits at the campground turnoff on CR 37, ~260 m NW of the catalog site centroid 39.43322,-105.85233. Under the 500 m line; re-pin to the centroid if wanted.
